principles: Use references as quality/composition/typography intelligence, not rigid templates.
Prefer one memorable visual idea per slide.
Typography must be intentional, mobile-first and confident.
Use light, dark, photography, CGI, surreal, collage or experimental directions when they are exceptional and story-fit.
Do not default to generic AI visual language.
Maintain a coherent campaign system while allowing slide-level variation.
The cover gets the most candidate generation and the strictest quality threshold.
